goal: Prevent validation calls from returning success while recording an error or polluting chained calls
Make validation return conventions safer and more predictable for maintainers
agreement: Contested objection: runtime asserts risk aborts instead of enforcing safe states via types (hodlinator)
Verified by testing block corruption during a reorg to confirm error logging is preserved (arejula27)
Broad concept support for returning validation status directly rather than through output parameters

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it modernizes internal validation interfaces without altering consensus behavior
Reduces code fragility by eliminating inconsistent return booleans and shared error state across calls
Remains deferrable as an internal code-safety cleanup with no user-visible impact
